name: vavly-skills
description: Skills and plugins for Claude Code, from Vavly. Tools that move oversight of AI-written code from approving each tool call to reviewing each outcome.

plugins.name: spec-gate
plugins.description: A review gate and spec-driven workflow. A Stop hook refuses to end a turn on a diff that has not been through adversarial review; a PreToolUse hook blocks production code until a spec exists and the user has approved it.
